Original_2018_FAIMS_Behavior: Custom BeanShell script in autonumbering-validation.bsh read internal SQLite table, maintained per-device counter, formatted string as MD{{Mound_ID}}.
Target_2026_GeoPackage_Approach: QGIS Default Value expression or SQLite triggers auto-generate sequential identifier with operator prefix (e.g. MD-MM-001).
Target_2026_Fieldmark_Approach: Fieldmark built-in autonum schema rule increments sequence and locks field upon creation.
ARCHAEOLOGICAL_RATIONALE_AND_NOTES: Essential for unique site, tree, and artefact referencing across survey teams.

Original_2018_FAIMS_Behavior: leave-gps-verification.bsh validated coordinates before user was permitted to advance past Location tab, requiring accuracy <= 15m.
Target_2026_GeoPackage_Approach: Geometry column enforced as NOT NULL. QGIS/QField snaps feature to GPS crosshair and records accuracy in gps_accuracy attribute.
Target_2026_Fieldmark_Approach: Mandatory GPS Location field with configurable accuracy threshold in Fieldmark form.
Applies_To_Forms: All Primary Feature Forms (Mounds, Shelters, Trees, Burials, Artefacts)
ARCHAEOLOGICAL_RATIONALE_AND_NOTES: Prevents orphaned features recorded without spatial coordinates.

Original_2018_FAIMS_Behavior: gis-shared.bsh required fieldworkers to record discrete Boundary Points (MD001-BP1, BP2...) which were algorithmically joined into a polygon.
Target_2026_GeoPackage_Approach: Native Polygon (feature_boundaries) and Line (feature_lines) layers digitized directly on Topcon FC-6000 screen or iPad retina display. Area (m²) and perimeter (m) calculated automatically.
Target_2026_Fieldmark_Approach: Native Polygon geometry attribute with automatic area calculation in Fieldmark.
Applies_To_Forms: Mounds, Surface Exposures, Rock Shelters, Historical Features
REVISED_LOGIC_REQUIREMENTS: Replaced 2018 boundary points with native vector digitizing; retain 1:N link to parent feature.
ARCHAEOLOGICAL_RATIONALE_AND_NOTES: Eliminates clumsy point-by-point perimeter entry. QGIS digitizing tools allow accurate perimeter tracing.

Original_2018_FAIMS_Behavior: Historic-trees module allowed one Tree record to generate multiple child Scar records (TR001-SC1, TR001-SC2) with custom morphometrics.
Target_2026_GeoPackage_Approach: QGIS 1:N Composition Relation between tree (record_id) and tree_scars (parent_tree_id). Child tab displays embedded scar table.
Target_2026_Fieldmark_Approach: Fieldmark parent-child subrecord collection for Scar entities inside Tree form.
ARCHAEOLOGICAL_RATIONALE_AND_NOTES: Culturally scarred trees frequently exhibit multiple scar events on different trunk faces.

Original_2018_FAIMS_Behavior: Parent mounds and exposures linked to child boundary points.
Target_2026_GeoPackage_Approach: QGIS 1:N Relation between feature (record_id) and feature_boundaries / feature_lines (parent_feature_id).
Target_2026_Fieldmark_Approach: Fieldmark subrecord or related spatial collection.
Applies_To_Forms: Mound, Surface Exposure, Rock Shelter, Historical Feature
ARCHAEOLOGICAL_RATIONALE_AND_NOTES: Enables complex multi-part boundaries or separate core vs periphery extents for a single site.

Original_2018_FAIMS_Behavior: cascade-delete.bsh manually traversed database and purged child boundary coordinates, scars, and file records when a parent record was deleted.
Target_2026_GeoPackage_Approach: SQLite FOREIGN KEY (parent_feature_id) REFERENCES parent(record_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, plus QGIS Composition Relation.
Target_2026_Fieldmark_Approach: Fieldmark automatic cascade delete on child collections.
Applies_To_Forms: All Parent Forms with linked Scars, Boundaries, or Media
ARCHAEOLOGICAL_RATIONALE_AND_NOTES: Prevents orphaned boundary polygons, scars, or media files remaining when a site is deleted.

Original_2018_FAIMS_Behavior: custom-search.bsh and find-in-map.bsh executed SQL text searches and commanded GIS map view to re-center on coordinates.
Target_2026_GeoPackage_Approach: Native QGIS Attribute Table filter, QGIS locator bar, and QField spatial search tool.
Target_2026_Fieldmark_Approach: Fieldmark native record search, sorting, and map clustering.
ARCHAEOLOGICAL_RATIONALE_AND_NOTES: Surveyors need to quickly locate existing recorded sites on their map while walking transects.

Original_2018_FAIMS_Behavior: Android camera intent saved photos to internal directory; separate external camera ID field required manual cross-referencing.
Target_2026_GeoPackage_Approach: Unified media_attachments table supporting Photos, Audio Voice Notes, PDF site plans, and field sketches, with QGIS form attachment widgets.
Target_2026_Fieldmark_Approach: Fieldmark Photo, Audio Memo, and File attachment fields with native camera/mic integration.
REVISED_LOGIC_REQUIREMENTS: Upgrade to multi-format media (Photos + Audio voice notes + PDF plans) linked by record_id.
ARCHAEOLOGICAL_RATIONALE_AND_NOTES: Modern field recording relies heavily on audio voice notes and digital PDF plans in addition to photos.
